changelog: **Generated Google Meet rooms (#2009):** a new org conferencing policy, `GENERATE_PROVIDER`. A timed meeting whose organizer has a connected Google Calendar gets a real Meet room. The room is created on their own calendar (`conferenceData.createRequest`) and becomes the meeting's single link. The request waits for Google at most 4 s (`GENERATE_TIMEOUT_MS`). On a timeout or error the meeting falls back to the saved personal room, then the built-in room, and the reason is recorded on the connection. The generated event is adopted as the calendar mirror, so no second event is created. The policy applies to `POST /api/meetings`, interview scheduling and meeting-request acceptance. Teams waits for #1991; Zoom is deferred by decision (`docs/conferencing.md`).

en: Organizations can now have a real Google Meet room created automatically for each scheduled meeting, on the organizer's own connected calendar.
tr: Kurumlar artık planlanan her toplantı için, düzenleyenin kendi bağlı takviminde otomatik olarak gerçek bir Google Meet odası oluşturabilir.
de: Organisationen können jetzt für jedes geplante Meeting automatisch einen echten Google-Meet-Raum im verbundenen Kalender der organisierenden Person erstellen lassen.
